violations.text: There was no person with a certificate from a food safety managers course present at the time of inspection. The establishment must have at least 1 person with a food safety managers certificate when food is being handled, prepared, and served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The certified food safety manager (FMC29396) was observed to be expired. The CFSM must renew with an updated food safety managers certificate. An application has been left with the person in charge. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Rodenticide was observed uncovered in the back room where the 3-bay sink is located. Rodenticide must be placed by a licensed pest control technician and stored in a manner to prevent possible sources of contamination of food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The establishment does not have a list of ingredients for the self-serve pastry items. A list of ingredients for all pastry items must be available upon request of customers. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
No person in charge with a food safety manager certificate was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the spray bottle was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

Per interview of staff, utensils (tongs) are only washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the end of the shift (every 8 hours). The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

The establishment does not have a list of ingredients for their self-service food items (baked goods, hot dogs, taquitos/tornados). Self-service items must have a list of ingredients readily available for consumers. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

The floors in the warewashing room has an accumulation of old rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024
